subject: RTO/RPO telemetry and keystore rotation sample for SOC2/SIG review
messages:
From: Kiera Walsh <kiera.walsh@latticehealth.com>
To: connor.obrien@redwood.com
Cc: compliance@latticehealth.com
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: RTO/RPO telemetry + keystore rotation evidence for SOC2 review

Connor —

Thanks for taking this. Our SOC2 auditor asked for a small, tangible sample set showing:
- RTO/RPO telemetry (timestamped timeline of a restore/runbook playback) — ideally a CSV with event/time and elapsed seconds
- KV cache warm-start traces for a recent failover test (to confirm cold vs warm restore behaviour)
- A signed keystore rotation manifest (who rotated, timestamps, and key fingerprints)

Can you confirm you can provide a scrubbed sample (no customer PII) and a short ops writeup that we can include in the SIG/CAIQ evidence bundle? We prefer files we can ingest into our evidence platform (CSV + PDF).

Also: would you be able to do a 30-minute live witness to replay the restore timeline next week? If so, please propose windows (we are Eastern).

Thanks — Kiera
Kiera Walsh
Sr. Compliance Manager | LatticeHealth
compliance@latticehealth.com


From: connor.obrien@redwood.com
To: Kiera Walsh <kiera.walsh@latticehealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RTO/RPO telemetry + keystore rotation evidence for SOC2 review

Hi Kiera —

Appreciate the clear ask. We can absolutely provide a small evidence bundle. Plan and ask below:

What we'll produce (deliver within 48 hours):
- rto_rpo_sample.csv — event, timestamp (UTC), elapsed_seconds, operator_id (redacted)
- ops-runbook-excerpt.pdf — 2-page excerpt describing restore steps and expected SLAs
- keystore-rotation-manifest.pdf — signed manifest with rotation metadata and key fingerprints (redacted where needed)
- short README.txt explaining what was redacted and how samples were generated

Questions / clarifications:
- Do you need FIPS-level HSM attestations or is the rotation manifest sufficient?
- Any constraints on timezone formatting (we'll provide UTC + local TZ columns)
- For the live witness: we can do a replay showing a restore and KV warm-start trace; would you prefer a live session or pre-recorded screen share first?

Tentative windows for live witness (we'll propose additional slots if these don't work):
- Mon 2027-08-30 10:00-10:30 EDT
- Tue 2027-08-31 14:00-14:30 EDT

I'll loop Ben (security) and Marissa (ops) to scope the artifacts. We'll follow up with a Drive link and an ops invite.

—Connor O'Brien
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RTO/RPO telemetry + keystore rotation evidence for SOC2 review

Kiera / team —

Quick technical note + what I'll attach:

1) rto_rpo_sample.csv (attached) — short example from a controlled restore we ran 2027-07-31. Column preview: event, utc_ts, elapsed_s, step_id, node_set. Sample rows (sanitized):

"event", "utc_ts", "elapsed_s", "step_id", "node_set"
"restore-init", "2027-07-31T18:02:03Z", "0", "init-01", "pool-a"
"kv-cache-apply", "2027-07-31T18:02:23Z", "20", "kv-apply-02", "pool-a"
"service-back-online", "2027-07-31T18:02:58Z", "55", "svc-check-04", "pool-a"

2) keystore-rotation-manifest.pdf (attached) — includes: rotation_id, rotated_by (redacted), old_key_fp, new_key_fp, rotation_ts (UTC), signature (ops signoff). We maintain an HSM-backed rotation flow; the manifest is the human-readable export used for audits.

3) ops-playback-invite.ics — we'll send an invite for a live witness session where we replay the restore in an isolated environment and walk through the CSV timeline and keystore manifest.

Notes:
- KV cache warm-start traces are included as a compressed excerpt inside the Drive folder (we'll provide the path). They contain low-level timing markers; we will fully redact any customer identifiers.
- If you need signed timestamps from a third-party TSA, let us know — we can coordinate but it will take additional time.

Links: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/collections/LatticeHealth-RTO-evidence (will be provisioned and shared)
JIRA ref: SEC-2048 (ops playback scheduling)

I'll upload the artifacts to the Drive and reply-all once done.

—Ben Carter
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Thanks Connor / Ben —

This is perfect. Please proceed with the deliverables and share the Drive link when ready. We confirm Mon 2027-08-30 10:00 EDT for a live witness (30 min) — we will invite our auditor and an engineering reviewer.

A couple of small asks:
- Please include UTC and EDT columns in the CSV for quick cross-reference.
- If you can generate a short MD5/SHA256 of the files we can ingest (hashes in the README), that would help our evidence chain.
- Please send a DocuSign CDA if you prefer to exchange the artifacts under a CDA before sharing.

Look forward to the Drive link.
